data.message: asking IBM Bob to read the onboarding docs

IBM Bob: This is the FastAPI framework source repo, not an end-user project. The README's 'run it' section (uv run fastapi dev) is aimed at users building their own app on top of FastAPI, not at contributors working in this repo. To serve a demo app from this source tree a main.py must first be created (as shown in the README example). The CI test command is 'uv sync --no-dev --group tests --extra all' followed by the test script; locally, running scripts/test.sh directly (without coverage flags) is the simpler equivalent. The python:3.12 Docker image satisfies the >=3.10 requirement in pyproject.toml. No database or external service is required for the standard test suite.
